name: Goldvein Hydra
oracle_text:
Vigilance, trample, haste
This creature enters with X +1/+1 counters on it.
When this creature dies, create a number of tapped Treasure tokens equal to its power.
blocked_sentences: This creature enters with X +1/+1 counters on it.
When this creature dies, create a number of tapped Treasure tokens equal to its power.

needs.what: the X paid for a permanent spell must be readable by that permanent's `self_enters_with_counters` replacement, so `amount` can be {"x": true} and a {X} creature arrives already the right size
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `x` is in `value_keys` and works in `spell_effects` and in a triggered ability (triggers.event_bindings binds x from obj.cast_x), but zones._enter_battlefield evaluates a replacement's `amount` with EffectContext(state, controller, source_oid) and no x, so ctx.x is 0 and the replacement silently puts on zero counters. The near miss is `{"count": {...}}`, which counts a board, not the cost paid. Writing it instead as a `self_enters` trigger running `add_counters` is a different card: 614.1c aside, a printed 0/0 Hydra would hit the battlefield at 0/0 and be binned by state-based actions before the trigger ever resolved.

needs.what: a `dies`/`leaves_battlefield` trigger must be able to read the dead permanent's last-known power and toughness — the values it had on the battlefield as it left, not its printed line
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `power_of` with {"self": true} goes through values._from_oid -> chars(), and by the time the dies trigger resolves the object is a graveyard card whose counters `reset_permanent_state` has already cleared, so it reads printed power (0 here). The DIES event carries only `had_counters`, so `counters_had` can recover the +1/+1 counters but not power — a different number the moment an anthem, a pump or a -1/-1 counter is involved. `snapshot` does not help either: it is an op, so it runs at resolution, after the creature has already left.
